task_id.description:
A UUID to identify the issue.
Optional. If it is not provided, it will be automatically generated.

title.description: Required. Title of the issue (maximum 255 characters).

description.description: Optional. Description of the issue (maximum 500 characters).

collaborators.description:
The collaborators involved in this issue.
Collaborators are users who have been assigned to the issue. The user will
appear in the "Assignee" field in the issue. Only one user can be assigned
to an issue at a time.

created_at.description:
Optional. The date and time this issue was created.
If no date is provided, the current time will be used.
Must be sent in the Internet Date-Time format, more information about the type is
available here:
https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/reference/google.protobuf#timestamp.

category_id.description:
Required. The ID of the issue's category.
Categories are configured at an organization level, and can be retrieved
from the `GetCategories` endpoint. The issue will not be created if the
category is missing, and an error will be returned.

status_id.description:
Optional. ID of the issue's status.
If not set, this issue will be stored with the default status (Open).
An issue can be open, in progress, or resolved, and these are represented
by hardcoded UUID values. Open status: `547ed646-5e34-4732-bb54-a199d304368a`.
In Progress status: `ca6f3bc7-b943-406e-8399-8a713b7e6268`.
Resolved status: `450484b1-56cd-4784-9b49-a3cf97d0c0ad`.

site_id.description:
The ID of the site associated with the issue.
Site IDs can be retrieved on platform.

location.description: The geographical location of the issue.

question_answers.description: Answers for questions on the issue.

items.description:
Optional. The category fields and questions that applied to this incident
when it was created.

occurred_at.description: Optional. Date and time this incident occurred at

asset_id.description: Optional. The ID of the asset associated with this issue.

ai_generated.description:
The Assistant passes the mitti-ai-marked header on the create call, so a
new caller sets it the same way. The field stays for existing callers.

s12.common.GeoPosition.description: A position is the fundamental geographical geometry construct.

text.description: The text that answers the question.

s12.tasks.v1.AnswerText.description: A type of answer for a custom question containing text data.

s12.tasks.v1.CollaboratorRole.description:
- ASSIGNEE: The collaborator has been assigned to a task.
 - CREATOR: The collaborator has created the task.
s12.tasks.v1.CollaboratorRole.title: The role of the collaborator in relation to a task

s12.tasks.v1.CollaboratorType.description:
- USER: The collaborator is an internal user.
 - GROUP: The collaborator is a group.
 - EXTERNAL_USER: The collaborator is an external user.
This happens when a task is assigned to an email address.
 - CONTRIBUTOR: The collaborator is a contributor.
A contributor is an individual who raises a task anonymously. For example,
creating an incident through the incident QR code functionality.
s12.tasks.v1.CollaboratorType.title: The type of the collaborator

is_mandatory.description: Whether or not the item must be filled before submission

is_disabled.description: Whether or not the item is disabled and hidden from submission

s12.tasks.v1.Item.ItemType.description: - ITEM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: The item type is unspecified
s12.tasks.v1.Item.ItemType.title: The types of items

id.description: The UUID of the multiple choice option.

text.description:
The text of the multiple choice option. This does not use the new `validator.string` option as question processing
logic fails when symbols are substituted for similar-looking symbols.

s12.tasks.v1.MultipleChoiceOption.description: MultipleChoiceOption represents a possible answer for a multiple choice question.

s12.tasks.v1.MultipleChoiceOptions.description: MultipleChoiceOptions is an explicit message for a set of MultipleChoiceOption's to use in a oneof field below.

text.description:
The text of the question being asked (e.g. "How many eggs are in a dozen?"). This does not use the new
`validator.string` option as question processing logic fails when symbols are substituted for similar-looking
symbols.

type.description: The type of the question. See `enum QuestionType` for more details.

is_mandatory.description: Whether the question is mandatory or not

s12.tasks.v1.Question.description: Question represents the question structure for a custom question.

s12.tasks.v1.Question.QuestionType.description:
- QUESTION_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: The question type is unspecified. This generally should not happen.
 - QUESTION_TYPE_TEXT: The question is text type. This question accepts freetext answers.
 - QUESTION_TYPE_MULTIPLE_CHOICE: The question is multiple choice. This question provides a list of options to choose from.
s12.tasks.v1.Question.QuestionType.title: The types of questions

question_id.description: The ID of the question being answered.

answer_text.description:
AnswerText indicates that the question being answered has a text
response.

answer_multiple_choice.description: MultipleChoiceOption indicates that the question being answered is a multiple choice question.

s12.tasks.v1.QuestionAnswer.description:
QuestionAnswer contains data about a question configured for this issue's
category, as well as the answer to that question.

name.description: The name of the task's location.

s12.tasks.v1.Task.AddressLocation.description:
The location of the task.
The latitude and longitude in the `geo_position` object are required.
All other fields are optional, but add extra context to the location on
platform.

collaborator_id.description: A UUID uniquely identifying this collaborator.

collaborator_type.description: The type of the collaborator i.e. group or user.

assigned_role.description: The role of the collaborator in this task.

user.description: Collaborator details for an authenticated user.

external_user.description: Collaborator details for an external user.

s12.tasks.v1.Task.Collaborator.description:
A collaborator is somebody who is involved with the task.
They have either created the task, or are assigned to it.

id.description: The UUID uniquely identifying this contributor

s12.tasks.v1.Task.Contributor.title: The contributor that raised the issue

id.description: The UUID uniquely identifying this external user.

email.description: The email address of the external user.

s12.tasks.v1.Task.ExternalUser.description: The external user that is assigned to a task.

s12.tasks.v1.Task.Group.description: The group that is assigned to a task.

firstname.description: The first name of the user.

lastname.description: The last name of the user.

s12.tasks.v1.Task.User.description: The user associated to the task. They could be a creator or assignee.
